_about: Every kind of thing the PRE-REVAMP alchemist made (master 067e516, rules/alchemist.py `preview` at level 5): the 44 spell potions by their own recipes; the 19 rows of the old recipe table (docs/alchemy.md at 067e516; a row its own rules refused is sealed without the refused step); every one of the 139 alchemist materials sealed alone, and in a clay flask when harmful; every material with a drawback dissolved, filtered and sealed; three unsealed intermediates; one chain the player named. Saved as the old /craft/ view saved them: crafting.from_stock_dict(dict(output, craft='alchemist')).as_dict(). `bought` is what the old counter and outfitter delivered for the CRB alchemical goods: Stock(base=name, craft='') with no document. `_how` names the working. Generated by alchemy lane I on 2026-10-07; not an owner save.
